perf_stat_p50_tip: Half of all requests were faster than this.
perf_stat_p90_tip: 9 in 10 requests were faster than this.
perf_stat_p95_tip: 19 in 20 requests were faster than this — the common SLA target.
perf_stat_p99_tip: 99 in 100 requests were faster than this — your slowest users.
perf_stat_throughput_tip: Requests completed per second — how much load was served.
perf_stat_error_rate_tip: Share of requests that failed (non-2xx / assertion failures).
perf_stat_samples_tip: Total requests sent during the run.
perf_badge_fail_tip: A latency or error budget was exceeded.
perf_badge_none_tip: Run finished; no pass/fail budgets were set.
perf_subtitle: Load-test scenarios from your test cases, run with JMeter
perf_toast_need_recipient: Enter at least one recipient email.
perf_toast_need_gmail_pass: Set the Gmail App Password on the Setup screen first.
perf_info_users: Concurrent virtual users driving the load.
perf_info_ramp: Seconds to ramp from 0 up to all users.
perf_info_duration: Seconds to hold the full load once ramped up.
perf_info_p95_budget: Pass/fail budget: the 95th-percentile latency limit, in ms.
perf_info_max_error: Pass/fail budget: the maximum allowed error rate, in percent.
perf_info_p99_budget: Optional pass/fail budget on the 99th-percentile latency. 0 = off.
perf_info_min_throughput: Optional pass/fail budget: fail if throughput drops below this. 0 = off.
perf_info_users_csv: A CSV with a username/email column and a password column.
perf_tip_edit_manually: Unlock these fields to set them by hand.
perf_info_request_body: How credentials are sent: JSON body or form-encoded.
perf_info_api_user_field: The field name your login API expects for the username.
perf_info_api_pass_field: The field name your login API expects for the password.
perf_info_csv_user_col: Which column in your CSV holds the username/email.
perf_info_csv_pass_col: Which column in your CSV holds the password.
perf_tip_fetch: Log every user in, collect a per-user token, and prepare the CSV.
perf_tip_run_jmeter: Run the load test and stream live progress in the Activity log.
perf_tip_open_folder: Open the folder with the generated plan.jmx, results and report.
perf_basket_summary: {n} scenario(s) · {r} request(s) — combined into one JMeter plan on Generate & Emit.
perf_tip_email_report: Email the report + JMeter dashboard .zip to the recipients.
perf_tip_open_qa_report: Open QA Studio's one-page summary (verdict, metrics, glossary).
perf_tip_open_jmeter_report: Open JMeter's full interactive dashboard (charts over time).
perf_tip_export_report: Save QA Studio's one-page HTML report to your computer.
